risks.risk: Wrong fitment (headlamp may be for a specific Honda/Acura model/year; compatibility is not readable).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the headlamp back/label showing part number and the exact vehicle model/year it fits.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used headlamp with unknown fitment (worst case: treat as not guaranteed for your exact car).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible (cracks, moisture inside, broken tabs/reflector damage).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the lens surface, mounting tabs, and the inside (view through the lens) plus a photo of the back housing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic/fitment defects (worst case: assume it may need repair/adjustment).

risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the headlamp switched ON with the correct bulb type and a clear view of the connector.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: assume it may not light).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the headlamp part number/label (back side) and the exact Honda/Acura model/year it fits.
Send close-ups of lens cracks, reflector condition, and all mounting tabs/brackets.
Send a short video of the headlamp ON (beam visible) and a clear shot of the connector/bulb type.
response.reason: The photo shows a headlamp, but the exact model/year fitment and working condition cannot be confirmed from the image; without that, a reliable price pick from the comparables isn’t safe.
